output.body: Isomorph: sum_to(n) equals 1+2+...+n, using sum_to(n) = n + sum_to(n-1) for n > 0 and the direct case sum_to(0) equals 0. Tracing sum_to(2) gives 2 + sum_to(1), then 1 + sum_to(0), and sum_to(0) is defined directly, so the chain ends with no further call.
output.key_idea: A recursive function stops when one input is handled by a direct rule that does not call the function again.
